messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service hosted-inference-prod (P1). escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager (staggered retries configured). Incident: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-78231 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Page 1 sent to @Jen K (primary). retry_count=0

Jen K: Acked. Jumping on the bridge in ~2m :phone:

Sam P: Seeing a spike in 5xx error-rate around 10:45 UTC, pulling runtime logs now.

Olivia R: Customer support report: degraded response time and intermittent failures from eu-west-1. Sales has one high-value customer pinged. Impact looks partial, but some requests time out and clients are retrying.

Maya L: Any prod deploys in the last hour? If not I can start tailing host logs and GPU metrics.

ops-bot: Deploy history: no production deploys since 2026-03-14T06:30Z (release 2026.03.14-0c9b).

Sam P: Tail snippet from host-09 (10:45:12-10:45:14 UTC):
```
2026-03-14T10:45:12Z runtime ERROR tokenization failed: OOM allocating 2048MB
2026-03-14T10:45:13Z runtime WARN evicting KV cache entry id=0x3f4a
2026-03-14T10:45:13Z runtime ERROR request_id=abcdef status=502 backend=llm-infer-3
```

Sam P: Appears to be memory pressure causing tokenization OOMs and cascading 502s. KV cache evictions observed under burst load.

incident-bot: Secondary did not ack within 30s. Scheduling staggered retries: attempt timings +30s, +2m, +5m. Manager escalation will fire if attempt 3 also unacked.

pagerduty-bot: Secondary page sent to @Alex M (attempt 1).

Alex M: Manager here, pinged. If secondary can't respond I'll join the bridge.

Jen K: Quick mitigation: disabling KV cache on pool llm-infer-3 to reduce memory footprint -> running:
`infractl serve update --pool llm-infer-3 --disable-kv-cache true`

Sam P: Restarted runtime on host-09. Post-restart services up but failures persist under high concurrency. Reducing concurrency and trying a small traffic reroute to spare capacity.

Sam P: Proposed temporary routing change to shift a small percentage of traffic to the dedicated reserve pool. Config idea:
```
routing:
  hosted-inference-prod:
    fallback: dedicated-inference-reserve
    fallback_ratio: 0.10
```

Maya L: +1 to a conservative reroute. Reduces tail pressure while we stabilize.

Olivia R: If we reroute, I'll update the status page and notify support with a short message. Draft: "We are experiencing elevated latencies and intermittent errors in eu-west-1. A portion of traffic has been routed to reserve capacity to mitigate impact. Engineers are investigating."

ops-bot: Reroute executed: hosted-inference-prod -> dedicated-inference-reserve fallback_ratio=0.10. Verified a few requests hit reserve.

ops-bot: Autoscale events temporarily suppressed for this incident to avoid thrash.

Sam P: Observability update: error-rate fell toward baseline after reroute + cache disable. Still intermittent timeouts during short bursts. Continuing monitoring.

incident-bot: Manager escalation triggered (attempt 3 reached). @Alex M added to the bridge.

Alex M: On bridge. Good mitigation so far. Keep the 10% fallback and continue restarts/checks on host-09. What do we need to stabilize?

Jen K: We'll keep cache disabled on affected pool and maintain the 10% fallback. Next step: increase burst cap on dedicated-reserve for 15m to absorb traffic.

Sam P: Running: `infractl capacity adjust --pool dedicated-inference-reserve --burst 2x`

Sam P: Done. Monitoring: latency/error-rate continuing to decline. Will watch for 20 minutes for regression.

Olivia R: Support message posted. Notifying affected customers with the mitigation note.

Maya L: Please add a short incident note in the tracker: suspected root cause = KV cache + OOM under burst concurrency. Mitigations applied: disabled KV cache, rerouted 10% to reserve, restarted host-09, increased reserve burst cap.

Jen K: Added notes. If we cross 4 hours or see regression, schedule postmortem.

Sam P: Follow-ups: revisit KV cache eviction policy, consider earlier prefix eviction threshold, and implement circuit-breaker for tokenization OOMs to fail fast and reduce cascading 502s.

Alex M: Thanks team — clean, fast mitigation. I'll stay on bridge until we're stable for another 30m. :thumbsup: 

Jen K: Handing bridge to Sam for continued watch in 30m. I'll sign off but remain available if needed.

incident-bot: Thread closed by Jen K (manual)."
